body: I think we should also test the behaviour when no parameterless constructor is provided.
Good point, it works fine without a parameterless ctor.

The tests will pass either way, because the generators/analyzers don't check that the type has a parameterless constructor, but having no parameterless constructor will fail at runtime if the script is attached.

Yeah. Now that I think about it, we don't check classes for a parameterless constructor even without using primary constructors. Maybe that's an analyzer we could add in the future. But the current test should be enough for this fix.
